notes.title: Maroon is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to inform you that Maroon has officially been released on Steam. You can now download and play the application for free. Upon launching the game, you can choose between the regular non-VR desktop and the Virtual Reality versions. Start one of the many STEM experiments, and experience physics, chemistry, or computer science firsthand.

We hope you enjoy the application. Please feel free to leave us any feedback you might have in the Steam Discussions forum. 

- Game Lab Graz
